angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 160,707 km at 18.88 pc = 0.11 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 52.9611 +/- 0.0122 mas (same row, RUWE 1.13): 18.88 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.231 +/- 0.015 solar radii from Scott et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-6716 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.547ag070S/abstract): 160,707 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.223 +/- 0.011 solar masses from Scott et al. 2026, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-6716 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.547ag070S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3110 +/- 80 K from Scott et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-6716 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.547ag070S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Scott et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-6716 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.547ag070S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-6716.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 5.059, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-6716 (pscomppars): spectral type M4, from Scott et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.547ag070S/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, UPM J0726-3033: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-6716 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0 dex, from Scott et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.547ag070S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-6716 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -2.31942, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
